purchase.purchase_source_type must additionally satisfy "in" (not modelled as a variant here; verify manually).

If your project tracks this data differently, open the aggregate and adjust it to match your tracking setup. — # purchases w/o discount code used: This aggregate uses 'discount_value' and 'voucher_code' to identify non-discounted purchases.
